challenges.title: Participant profile
challenges.description: Declare what a participant is: a person, an AI agent, or a robot. The profile is self-attested and must say what it does not claim.

challenges.title: Market listing
challenges.description: Check that a listing is a well-formed offer whose terms stay inside the policy, and that it makes no promise of a return.

challenges.title: Network aggregate
challenges.description: Check a claim about what the network thinks. The aggregate is recomputed from independent, verified contributions, and it only counts as a network answer when enough distinct participants contributed.
